title: Bound an explicit randomized simplex-grid observation law
statement: LetM=2^b,C_i(x)=sum_(j<=i)x_j,U~Uniform[0,1],R0=0,RK=M,R_i=floor(M C_i(x)+U) fori<K,andZ_i=(R_i-R_(i-1))/M. This SYSTEMATIC RANDOM rounding stays on the simplex grid and each cumulative coordinate is unbiased. Using the SAME U forx,y gives P(Z(x,U)!=Z(y,U))<=M sum_(i<K)|C_i(x)-C_i(y)|<=M(K-1)||x-y||1/2, since every zero-sum partial difference is at mosthalfL1. This yields whole random-gridTV from a latent transport coupling. Its law differs from deterministic rounding; the factorM is explicit and finite-bit known-parameter comparisons/random sampling costs are separate, not automatically polynomial inb.
